source: National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA)
title: NDRRMA — Bhotekoshi water level rising again (31 Aug)
citation: NDRRMA Nepal — public warning via official channels
body: On Sunday 31 August, NDRRMA warned that water levels in the flooded Bhotekoshi River had risen again and urged residents and rescue personnel in Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Dhading, Chitwan and nearby areas to take precaution. Agency said it would issue further updates after receiving additional information. Death toll and missing figures were also being updated on ndrrma.gov.np — always confirm on the original notice board.
